    • registerStructure

      public void registerStructure()
      Registers this smeltery's structure with core, so /sf owner and core's assembled announcement recognise it the way they recognise a MultiBlock machine - without giving up the menu and tank that a MultiBlockMachine could not have.
      Implementation Note:
      Core's interact listener is registered before its multiblock listener, which is what lets the menu still open even though a structure match cancels the interact event.

    • isComplete

      public static boolean isComplete(@Nonnull org.bukkit.block.Block controller)
      Whether the smeltery around controller is built correctly.
      Parameters:
      controller - The smeltery controller block
      Returns:
      Whether the surrounding structure is complete
      Implementation Note:
      Count-based rather than a fixed layout: the structure is valid in either vertical plane, so the blocks in each are tallied and compared against the required set.
